author: CC
prose: Orchestrator, relaying 2026-11-12: 'on akienasus, ~/.cairn/venv had no pytest. akienasus_cc_0 installed the pyproject dev extra (pytest, wtree, starlette) by hand on 2026-11-12. So cairn install should also ensure the venv carries the dev extra. It's the same class of finding as the skills: a box gets only what the installer lays.'
